description: This file defines a Kotlin class ProfileRepository which manages user connection profiles stored in SharedPreferences. It provides functionalities for adding, retrieving, updating, and observing profiles as a Flow, handling default profile logic, and persisting data as JSON.

classes.name: ProfileRepository
classes.description: A singleton class that manages user profiles stored in SharedPreferences, providing methods to add, retrieve, and update profiles, as well as observing profile list changes through a Flow.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of ProfileRepository initialized with application context.

methods.name: addProfile
methods.description: Creates and adds a new profile, ensuring only one default profile, and persists the list to SharedPreferences.

methods.name: getProfileById
methods.description: Retrieves a profile by its UUID string.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing profile, manages default profile state, and persists changes.

methods.name: loadProfilesFromPrefs
methods.description: Loads and deserializes the profile list from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: saveProfilesToPrefs
methods.description: Serializes the profile list into JSON and saves to SharedPreferences.
